user.title: Welcome to Pattern Pilot
user.description:
Pattern Pilot watches what people in your home do by hand, learns the routines and later suggests automations. Everything stays local and nothing needs to be set up by hand: sensors, Energy dashboard meters, holidays, sun and weather are used automatically.

This version only collects data. Suggestions need about 3 weeks of history.

data_description.history_days: Pattern Pilot keeps its own history, independent of the recorder.
data_description.analysis_time: Maintenance and (later) analysis run once a day at this time.
data_description.sensitivity: How big a sudden change of a sensor must be to count as an event. Each sensor learns its normal variation during the first day.

tracking.title: What to watch
tracking.description: Default = the whole house. Configuration and diagnostic entities are always skipped.

data_description.domains: "sensor" = measured values (humidity, temperature, power, light, CO₂ …) and Energy dashboard meters – only sudden rises and falls are stored.
data_description.areas: Leave empty to watch the whole house. People are always watched.
data_description.exclude_users: Actions of these users are not counted as manual actions.
